constraints.description: Tenant identity is distinct from user identity, originates only from verified claims, and cannot be overridden by request body, query, or headers.

validation.validation_method: Focused verifier and spoofing assertions plus A1 unverified-token denial evidence

constraints.description: Task ID, context ID, cancel, and gRPC paths partition by verified tenant and preserve same-tenant access.

validation.validation_method: Focused store/gRPC controls and live two-tenant C-21 positive and inverted assertions

constraints.description: When JWT is required, tenant-scoped HTTP and gRPC surfaces reject a verified token that establishes no tenant.

validation.validation_method: HTTP and gRPC positive assertions with separate observed-failing guard inversions

constraints.description: The pinned server-full phase command passes at or above the 29-case floor, strict OpenSpec validates, and A2 does not scope runs, memory, or knowledge bases.

validation.validation_method: Pinned Tier 2 output, strict OpenSpec validation, verification record, and scoped diff inspection

global_rules: Use the A2 OpenSpec delta and EXECUTION-CONTRACT.md as acceptance authority.
Report results only for server-full and transfer them to no other profile.
Never derive a tenant boundary from an unverified token.
Do not expand A2 scope to runs, memory, or knowledge bases.
termination_conditions: Every fail-closed assertion retains literal observed-failing output.
